_comment: The emtk shell's Analysis dock: the current fit, its controller (the Qt fit controller's fitting_controls.view.json, actions bound to chisurf.emtk.fit_docks.AnalysisModel) and, below it, the model's own editor (chisurf.emtk.model_editor). The flat parameter table stands in only for a model without an editor.
title: Analysis

sections.title: Fit
sections.description: Run and configure the fit of the selected dataset.

buttons.label: Fit
buttons.description: Optimise the free parameters of the current fit.

buttons.label: MCTS
buttons.description: Search the model structure with BFF's Monte Carlo tree search: every candidate structure the model declares is refined and scored, and the winner is applied to the fit. Shown only for models BFF can search.

buttons.label: Sample
buttons.description: Sample the posterior of the free parameters. Writes the chains, the diagnostics and the project to a folder.
Sampling and fitting settings: which sampler, thinning, chunk size, χ² cutoff, chain format and the optimiser tolerances. Saved to your settings.

buttons.label: auto
buttons.description: Choose the fit range from the data: the rising edge to where the signal reaches the background.
Attach a different dataset to this fit.

buttons.label: Remove fit
buttons.description: Remove the current fit and close its window.

sections.label: Dataset
sections.description: Which dataset of this fit the controls act on (a global fit has one per member).

sections.label: Result
sections.description: Which stored result of this fit is shown.

sections.label: First
sections.description: Index of the first data point the fit uses (the first column of a 2-D grid).

sections.label: Last
sections.description: Index of the last data point the fit uses (the first row of a 2-D grid).

sections.label: First (2)
sections.description: Last column of the second axis, for two-dimensional data.

sections.label: Last (2)
sections.description: Last row of the second axis, for two-dimensional data.

sections.label: Local first
sections.description: Optimise each dataset on its own before the global fit, which usually starts the global step much closer to the optimum.

sections.label: Search fit settings
sections.description: Let MCTS also try other ways of fitting each candidate structure: looser and tighter tolerances, the first declared start only, the parent's values as the start, a smaller first step. Each is scored like a structure, so one only wins by fitting better. Slower; use it when a structure fails to converge from its declared start. Saved to your settings.

The model's parameters. Double-click a value or bound to type it; click Fixed or Bounds to toggle. Computed outputs are dimmed; a linked parameter follows its master (drawn in blue, its tooltip names the master) and is read only.

columns.label: Name
columns.description: The parameter's name in the model.

columns.label: Value
columns.description: The parameter's value; double-click to type a new one.

columns.label: Fixed
columns.description: A fixed parameter keeps its value when the fit runs.

columns.label: Lo
columns.description: Lower bound, used while Bounds is on.

columns.label: Hi
columns.description: Upper bound, used while Bounds is on.

columns.label: Bounds
columns.description: Keep the parameter between Lo and Hi while fitting.

columns.label: Error
columns.description: Uncertainty estimate from the last fit.

columns.label: Prior
columns.description: Box keeps the plain lower/upper bounds; a family (Gaussian, Log-normal, ...) attaches a smooth prior pulling the fit toward a value. Type a family and its shape parameters, e.g. Gaussian(4, 0.4).
